module_name_note: The legacy module/file name is retained only for drop-in engine filelist selection; this implementation has9rows and144 paired lanes. Compile exactly one implementation.
base: Frozen winograd_task9 with only paired PE substitution and one central completion delay
public_interface: Same ports and32bit streams as prefetch8. pair_group is LOAD target; pair_loaded pulse retains the committed group for one cycle then advances. out_tile and pair_done_index are independent COMPUTE/output identities.
numeric: Unchanged signed INT8 X/W,INT16 bias,per-channel0..47 shift,RNE ties-even and signed8 saturation. All R/C factors computed in hardware on accepted loads and invalidated at BEGIN. No fitting or software factor inputs.

X_stream.mapping: Exactly the original rowpair adapter layout: wordi,rp=i/32,kp=i%32,bytes X[2rp,2kp],X[2rp,2kp+1],X[2rp+1,2kp],X[2rp+1,2kp+1].
X_stream.last_dummy_row: Words1568..1599 still handshake, but contain only row98 in their low half. The high half is the adapter-generated dummy row99 and must be zero in a canonical stream. It never writes an X bank, creates an R factor, or participates in compute. This core still consumes all1600 words, not a shortened1584-word stream.
X_stream.physical_mapping: bank=row mod9, address=floor(row/9)*32+kp. Each of9banks stores11rows=352words at0..351 in a1024x16 macro.
X_stream.hardware_addressing: A low-row bank counter0..8 and group counter advance by2 rows after each32word rowpair: ifbank>=7 subtract7 and incrementgroup, else add2. High row uses nextbank, with bank8 wrapping tobank0/group+1. No divider/modulo9 datapath is required.
X_stream.verification: Independent TB uses integer division/modulo of the logical row to check every actual macro write, including lowbank8/highbank0 cross-group wrapping and all32 ignored dummy high halves.

compute: 99rows=11groups of9 exactly. Each group issues32Kpairs to144 paired lanes. All9R values read through the independent R macros during the first9DOT issue cycles. No padded compute rows exist.
output: Unchanged16tile-major Y streams,396words/tile. Each9row group outputs36words; output index=group*36+localrow*4+word. Hardware constant36 is shifts/adds. Snapshot context remains immutable until the final raw-output ACK.
W_and_metadata: Unchanged16W128x16 banks/four slots,3x256bit burst contexts with21address bits,only non-DOT write grants,real metadata-cache read/write arbitration,slot release only at tile's final output ACK.

logic_state.new_control: Wider local-row/R index plus bounded modulo9 X bank/group counters; additional control/mux cost is not free.

why9_not16: With4-byte output,9row36-cycle store already exceeds35-cycle paired compute. Both9row and16row can approach first35+396=431cycles/tile;16row would add substantially more PE/SRAM for no better interface-limited bound. Actual W grants,metadata deadlines and backpressure must still be measured.

Independently verify all9-bank mappings,144lane full-signed arithmetic,176snapshots/1584Rreads,slot/burst/metadata protocol,all output addresses,reset/backpressure/errors,and four-state SRAM write-Q poison. change: Each of144 lanes replaces registered product18+valid/first/last3 by combinational signed9x9→23-bit accumulation. One shared delayed level-valid preserves the original DOT_WAIT capture cycle and W single-port write opportunities; all other task9 scheduling is byte-equivalent.
single_stage_protocol: Completed accumulator and valid held under backpressure; input accepted only if no held output or same-edge output ACK. First accepted pair clears accumulator, last accepted pair publishes output. Reset invalidates output and sum. Central delay also resets with core_rst_n.
